zh-CN.title: 聊天查找细节修复
items: 进一步压缩聊天查找列表，并修复链接换行、发言转发者、合并消息和系统消息展示
视频和语音时长现在拥有可靠的元数据回退，不再出现无效时长

en.title: Chat search detail fixes
items: Chat search rows are denser, with fixes for link wrapping, post forwarders, merged messages, and system-message filtering
Video and voice durations now use reliable metadata fallbacks and no longer show invalid values
